Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations

Annotation Interface HttpTrigger

@Retention(SOURCE) @Target(METHOD) public @interface HttpTrigger
Declares that a function should be exposed via an HTTP endpoint.

This annotation provides HTTP metadata such as method, path, summary, and operation ID, which can be used by code generators to configure API gateways or HTTP routing (e.g., AWS API Gateway, GCP Cloud Functions, Azure HTTP Triggers).

It is typically used in combination with Function to describe the HTTP-facing contract of a function.

Example


 @Function(name = "hello")
 @HttpTrigger(
     method = "GET",
     path = "/hello/{name}",
     summary = "Says hello",
     description = "Returns a greeting using the given name",
     operationId = "sayHello"
 )
 public String handleRequest(@PathParam("name") String name) {
     return "Hello, " + name + "!";
 }

Code generators may use this information to:

  • Generate OpenAPI documentation
  • Configure routing rules in serverless platforms
  • Generate client SDKs
